key_insight: RS-MFBO cuts the cost of optimizing expensive process simulators by combining sensitivity-based dimension reduction with multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization.
engineering_relevance: This gives process engineers a practical way to optimize industrial flowsheets with far fewer high-fidelity simulations while preserving strong solution quality.
method: Use Global Sensitivity Analysis to keep only the most influential decision variables.
Fit a fidelity-aware Gaussian process that links cheap approximations to expensive simulator outputs.
Apply cost-aware acquisition with cooldown and promotion rules to decide which fidelity to sample next.
evidence_signal: The framework was tested on two industrial simulators—SuperPro Designer for plasmid DNA bioprocessing and Aspen HYSYS for green fuel synthesis—and reduced high-fidelity evaluations while staying competitive with single-fidelity baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the reduced variable set and the fidelity correlation; weak sensitivity estimates or poor low-to-high fidelity alignment can limit gains.
paper_title: Reduced-Space Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization of Process Simulation Models
